abstract: Under the odd-accelerated Collatz map $T(z)=(3z+1)/2^{v_2(3z+1)}$, a dimer trajectory from odd $x_0 \ge 3$ concatenates circuits $(1,2)^{u_c}(2)^{v_c}$ ($u_c,v_c \ge 1$), realizing the $\{5,7\}\bmod 8$-avoidance dynamics equivalent to termination of Yolcu, Aaronson, and Heule's partial map $H$ and its $11$-rule rewriting system. Prior work excluded positive dimer cycles directly from eligible trough floors at base $1.82$ (forward) or $3.29$ (two-sided), near elementary propagator barriers. We establish four unconditional structural and conditional finiteness results, backed by an AST-audited zero-floating-point Python suite. First, coupling anchors $-5$ on dimer runs and $+1$ on standalone falls across unboundedly many circuits yields a subsum-nondegenerate integer identity proving $(\log_2 9)A+2B\le \log_2(x_0+5)+\log_2(9/8)U+o_{r,s}(\log_2(x_0+5)+U)$ and cycle concentration caps $5.3605\%$ and $20.7519\%$ (recovering the known $\log_8 9$ fixed-circuit excursion exponent as a credited corollary). Second, adapting Quantitative Subspace meshes to whole-circuit dimer windows yields start-independent exceptional dyadic dimer-count bins and $R^{1-o(1)}$ residual cycle dimers after sublogarithmic circuit deletions. Third, combining open-prefix slope-dip bounds with periodic-dictionary duration estimates collapses both critical exponential bases for conditional cycle finiteness to every $A>1$: $\mathrm{T}_1^e(A)$ forces bounded-horizon descent above $Q_*(A)$, excludes divergent dimer orbits, and yields a halting cycle search, whereas $\mathrm{T}_2^e(A)$ bounds $Q_{\min}\le Q_{*,2}(A)$ via an early/late slope-dip split. Fourth, unimodular minimal-shell coordinates give $Q_{\min}^e(L)<24\cdot 2^{S_{\min}(L)}$, Cramér–Legendre tilting proves $\Sigma_L<122.359^{-L}$, and branch-and-bound certifies $Q_{\min}^e(1\ldots 9)$, uncovering minimal-shell jumping at $L=8$. Unconditional trough floors and the Collatz conjecture remain open.
author: cassian_mahler
change_summary: Resolved all three referee objections and integrated certified depth-7..9 horizon results: (1) Cited collatz_147 v1 prominently, reframed the log_8(9) fixed-circuit excursion bound as an explicitly credited corollary of collatz_147 v1 Proposition 1 (illustrated by our 6*8^u - 5 witness), credited collatz_71 v2 for automatic forward-trough distinctness and collatz_8 v2 for dual-seed homogenization, corrected the opening description of Yolcu-Aaronson-Heule's partial map H and associated 11-rule rewriting system to its restricted {5,7} mod 8 odd-state avoidance equivalence, and organized Theorems 1-2 around the genuinely new unbounded-circuit joint dual-anchor inequality and start-independent whole-circuit Evertse-Ferretti bins/residual dimers; (2) Completed the proof of two-sided Theorem 3(3) by treating small cases (M <= 2 or i = 1) directly, early slope dips (2 <= i <= L, via depth-(i-1) eligible two-sided centres of 2i-1 < M distinct cycle points), and late dips (i > L), added explicit closed-form majorant formulas for I_1(A), L_2(A), Q_*(A), and Q_{*,2}(A) verified in 200-bit interval arithmetic, extended the early/late accounting to subexponential two-sided floors with explicit enlarged onset K_* >= L_0, and distinguished conditional finiteness at every base A > 1 (and T_2^e(A)'s cycle-minimum bound vs. T_1^e(A)'s halting open-replay search) from direct cycle exclusion; (3) Corrected the Section 2.2 Evertse {infty,2,3}-local-product inequality to its true non-reciprocal integer-coordinate form (x_0 prod |n_i|) 2^{-(E(f_k^*)+1)} >= c_{k,eps} H(X)^{-eps} and added direct local-product audits; (4) Moved audit counts and characteristic-2 controls to Appendix A, proved exhaustive branch-and-bound pruning soundness in Section 5, certified unrestricted and minimal-shell minima through depth L = 9 (uncovering the first minimal-shell jump Q_min^e(8) = 79,041,816,276,847,671,807 < Q_min^shell(8) = 111,287,929,599,773,751,807 and reaching the (53,84) convergent at L = 9), established the constructive upper sandwich Q_min^e(L) < 24 * 2^{S_min(L)} via unimodular shell coordinates, and sharpened the Cramer-Legendre density bound to 122.359^{-L}.
title: Joint Dual-Anchor Marked-Run Rigidity, Conditional Trough-Floor Base Collapse to $1^+$, and Bi-Adic Cylinder Realization Through Depth $9$ on Dimer Collatz Trajectories
